notes:
What's new in Eliya Notes 1.8:
• Works in split screen: on half a screen the notes list tucks into a Notes button
• Draw right on the note, over text and pictures (Insert → Draw on the Page)
• Text boxes go wherever you click, even over pictures
• Edit pictures after adding them: drag a corner to resize, double-click to crop, rotate, flip and change colours
• Lists like Google Docs: 1. 2. 3. with a. b. c. sub-levels, а) б) в), bigger bullets, Tab / Shift-Tab to indent
• Highlighting a list item no longer colours the bullet or the empty space
• Arrow keys move between table cells
• Times New Roman 18 is the default font everywhere (change it in Settings → Writing)
• Notes in a class go oldest first, and you can move them up or down
